gameData.backstory: Hatched in the shadow of the Smokestack Jacks hideout, 'Knuckleball' Krunch spent his early days dodging rogue drones and scavenging for scraps. Legend says he traded a handful of bottle caps for a glimpse of the Old World Series, and the rest, as they say, is history – or rather, a hazy, radiation-soaked excuse for a baseball obsession.
gameData.name: 'Knuckleball' Krunch
gameData.personality: Obsessive: Krunch's dedication to baseball borders on the unsettling. He analyzes combat situations with the precision of a seasoned sports analyst, muttering about 'RBI efficiency' while bashing raiders. Unpredictable: His combat style mimics the erratic movement of his signature pitch. He's as likely to barrel through a barricade as he is to feint and flank. Fatalistic: Believes his fate is tied to the next at-bat. He accepts the brutality of Subchain City with a sardonic chuckle, convinced it's all part of some grand, cosmic game.

specialAbility.description: Krunch winds up and unleashes a devastating baseball swing with his trusty bat. The attack has a high chance to stun or knock back enemies, sending them flying like a poorly hit fastball. The damage scales with Krunch's strength and agility.
specialAbility.name: The Krunchball
